services.name: Programs
services.desc: One school, six ways in. From your first self-defense class to elite law enforcement training, from kids learning focus to adults getting in the best shape of their lives. Find where you fit and start this week. Every program is taught by Colorado's most experienced Krav Maga instructors. No katas. No rituals. Just skills that work. The world's most battle-tested self-defense system, built for real life. Voted Best Self-Defense in Colorado and delivered by world renowned top certified experts. This is not a sport. This is survival. This is confidence. This is skill. This is confidence backed by skill, the only kind that matters. Teenagers have it hard. What makes it easier? Real confidence.
